primary_reading.fact: Explains mandatory rounded-root radius0.108-0.144P forUNR and ordinary2A/2B fit. Rolled production is typical, not proof a genericlisting or delivered bolt has the specified profile. Plating/thread-gage fit does not establish steel-core root diameter.

An ordinary3/8-16 Grade5 partially threaded hex cap screw explicitly listsUNR, SAEJ429 material/mechanical properties andANSI B18.2.1 dimensions. This1.75in example is a profile-family witness only, not a compatible substitute for a current bolt. Exact current lengths, price, availability and a numerical root/runout floor are not established by this page.

Table6 full-body minima0.369/0.493in are separate from thread root. Class2A applies before coating with stated coating/gaging provisions. Lb is last-scratch/extrusion coordinate; Lg is stopped specialGO-gage face, not first fully formed thread or guaranteed nut-travel coordinate. practical_proposal.bolt: Specify ordinary full-body partially-threaded SAEJ429_201405Grade5 hex cap screws, coarse3/8-16 or1/2-13 and an explicitUNRC-2A rounded-root form; retain catalog lengths as first proposal. Retain the qualified F60692ksi material hypothesis. Do not substitute a reduced body, full-thread rod, carriage head, cut bolt or unknown grade.
practical_proposal.root_floor: If these proposed Dr values are adopted for design, specify the steel-core root/no-undercut floor over the actual threaded AND transition wood-bearing intervals as an explicit dimensional purchase hypothesis. UNR/class gaging alone is not evidence of that numeric floor. This ordinary performance specification requires no custom machined hardware or blanket new manufacturer approval; catalog/delivered conformance to it remains unobserved.
practical_proposal.wood_method: Keep nominal placement diameter D distinct from yield-equation Dr. NDS12.3.7 permits Dr when thread bearing exceedsonequarter, or detailed threaded bearing/moment analysis as described in AppendixI. The76 prior intervals are not automatic bolt rejection. No new reference resistance or adopted group pass is calculated.
practical_proposal.nut_washer: Retain matching SAEJ995Grade5 coarse nuts and two own USS flat washers from the reviewedcatalog proposal. Select existing-length stack assignments within the published washer/nut windows and free nut seating/fillet fit. Do not add washer packing or blindly thin washers: washer bending, support area, seating couple and material remain separate.
practical_proposal.length_window: Reuse measured/purchase inequality L>=S+w_head+w_nut+h_nut+2pitch and sound free nut seating at own pressure plane. Existing-length maximum-stack intake minima are112.268mm for16×3/8×4.5,150.368mm for4×3/8×6,199.79249230769233mm for4×1/2×8. Next5/7/9in stock has1.0668/7.4168/5.9944mm worst grip-gage excess and12.7/25.4/25.4mm additional outward nominal tip; it is not a blanket fix.
